items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I read something about a show that Charles Dillingham had. Do you know that name? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I'm trying to think about

ctx.x: I came back, I came back in 1940. No, I didn't, I didn't get back until 1940. I think I, I, I, I went to, I think it was my dad's funeral or my mother's. I can't remember which one, 1940. Because I was in the Army when, when the other, one of the, one of the other died and I was out of Vallejo, California at that time. But anyway, but the, the only time I, I got home, I, I, I got home on a vacation when I was with Ben Pollack's band. I don't remember now. We were playing at the Florentine Grill Room at the Park…

Yeah, I, I, I thought maybe you'd come back when you were pretty rich. I read something about a show that Charles Dillingham had. Do you know that name? Dillingham. Yeah, Charles Dillingham had a show. Where? In New York. This was in the, this was in the, in the local, you know, uh, 174 magazine. The Union magazine, yeah.
I'm trying to think about, you see, he asked the hotel, you, you, you, you've been in New York.
